sentences.en: Let's pray to God, and He will answer our prayers.
sentences.zh: 让我们向上帝祈祷吧，他会回应我们的祷告。

sentences.en: Ha-ha-ha, pray forgive me. Please don't worry yourself about that!
sentences.zh: 哈哈哈哈哈，请原谅我。请别为那件事担心！

sentences.en: I pray that you will have the best of luck.

phrases.zh: 穆斯林做礼拜（或：穆斯林祈祷）
